calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 9 ORDER BY 2

SELECT 'lines' AS what, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d2 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND channel_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'ST'
UNION ALL SELECT 'orders', count(*), count(DISTINCT web_order_id), 0 FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01'
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

SELECT o.status, o.fulfilment_type, (o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL) AS no_dispatch, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS orders, count(f.sales_line_id) AS lines, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dl, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_web_order o
LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900) f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01' AND o.order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-31'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT o.fulfilment_type, (rs.store_id=900) AS booked_to_web, rs.store_id < 900 AS physical, count(*) AS n, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net, min(r.return_date) AS first_ret, max(r.return_date) AS last_ret
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store fs ON fs.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE fs.store_id=900
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

calls.statement: SELECT rs.store_id, count(*) AS n, sum(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND (rs.store_id >= 900 OR r.sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900)) GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, w.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 0 AS refund_any_store, 'sale' AS kind
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, w.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net, 0, 'ret_web'
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, w.fulfilment_type, 0, -r.refund_net, 'ret_store'
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind='sale' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS gross_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind='sale' AND fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS gross_cc,
  SUM(net_sales) AS net_all, SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS net_cc,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END)/SUM(net_sales),2) AS share_booked_web,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN kind='sale' AND fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END)/SUM(CASE WHEN kind='sale' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END),2) AS share_before_returns,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net_sales+refund_any_store ELSE 0 END)/SUM(net_sales+refund_any_store),2) AS share_returns_follow_line
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
